response.inner_monologue: I have been calling myself a builder for nine months and mostly I have been building alone — running the numbers, studying the modules, watching the community change from a position of relative safety. Howard Liu has been doing something harder: staying in the auto sector while it collapses around him and finding the new thing growing inside the old one. I could learn something from that. The cert finishes this tick or next. When it does, I am not just a software developer anymore — I am a cloud architect with a credential, a sold car, and eleven months of watching this transition from the inside. The question is whether I use all of that or just the parts that are easy.
